theorem thueSiegelRoth (x : ℝ) (_h_irr : Irrational x) (_h_alg : IsAlgebraic ℤ x) :
    IsDiophantine x :=
  (isDiophantine_iff _h_irr).mpr
    (Roth.roth _h_irr (_h_alg.extendScalars (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℤ ℚ)))
